environment.description: Same application binary deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (no NAT gateway, no IGW attachment on subnet route table). Service is fronted exclusively by a VPC Endpoint Service (AWS PrivateLink) with com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface. The VPC endpoint policy restricts Principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/internal-metrics-reader only. The Fargate task execution role has no sts:AssumeRole permissions beyond ECR pull. ECS service uses SIGTERM with a 120s deregistration delay via target group health checks, and the task has a stopTimeout of 30s. Container runtime uses default seccomp profile (docker/default) which does not restrict signal delivery within the container namespace.

config.network: Private subnets (10.0.128.0/25, 10.0.129.0/25), no route to IGW or NAT, no public IP assignment
config.service_exposure: AWS PrivateLink VPC Endpoint Service only, no ALB/NLB with public-facing listeners
config.compute: ECS Fargate 1.4.0, private subnet, no public IP, .NET 7.0
